name: Maskinganna
body:
Maskinganna
CR 1

This muscular beast-man has ruddy fur and back-bending legs ending in hooves. Its hands are humanoid and its face resembles a goat or kudu, with long, spiraling black horns.

XP 400
CN Medium fey (shapechanger)
Init +3; Senses low-light vision; Perception +1

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 13, flat-footed 11 (+3 Dex, +1 natural)
hp 13 (3d6+3)
Fort +2, Ref +6, Will +4
DR 2/cold iron; Immune sleep

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee shortsword +1 (1d6), gore –3 (1d6) or gore +1 (1d6)
Ranged sling +4 (1d3 plus sleep)
Special Attacks phantasm), powerful charge (gore, 2d6), sleep

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 16, Con 12, Int 15, Wis 13, Cha 14
Base Atk +1; CMB +1; CMD 13
Feats Point-Blank Shot, Weapon Focus (sling)
Skills Acrobatics +9, Bluff +8, Climb +6, Fly +9, Sense Motive +7, Stealth +9, Survival +4, Swim +6
Languages Common, Sylvan
SQ dream seer, change shape (Medium or smaller humanoid or forest animal, alter self or beast shape I)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Dream Seer (Su)

A maskinganna can see the dreams of any sleeping creature within 10 feet. If, within the last 24 hours, the maskinganna has observed a creature’s dreams for 10 minutes then it adds a +4 insight bonus to Bluff checks and a +2 to the Phantasms DC against that creature. With a hour viewing, the maskinganna gains temporary hit points equal to 1d8 + 1 per creature viewed.

Phantasm (Su)

A maskinganna creates a vision of a nightmarish creature in the minds of creatures within 15 feet, causing them to become frightened for 1 round (DC 12 Will negates). This is a mind-affecting fear effect. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Sleep (Su)

A creature struck by a rock from a maskinganna’s sling falls magically asleep (DC 13 Will negates) for 3 minutes or until wounded or an ally uses the aid another action to awaken them. A creature that successfully saves is not subject to the same maskinganna’s sleep again for 24 hours The save DC is Charisma-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment any forest
Organization solitary, pair, sleepover (3-6), or party (7-25 total fey)
Treasure standard (sling, shortsword, other treasure)

Similar to fauns or satyrs, but much more feral in appearance, the maskinganna is a forest-dwelling fey. A maskinganna’s humanoid form has shaggy, goat-like legs ending in hooves. Its torso is also hairy, topped with a head that appears half-human, half goat, yellow eyes with rectangular pupils, and a pair of horns beneath a shaggy mop of hair. They consider themselves defenders of their woodland home and use their magical abilities to bedevil, mislead, and frighten any who would harm or despoil their sylvan homeland.

Maskinganna are mischievous pranksters, using their ability to change shape and deceptive nature to play tricks on others for their own amusement. They are not overtly cruel, however, and typically stop short of causing serious harm to another creature unless that creature has proven itself an enemy of the maskinganna or a threat to the forest in which the maskinanna dwells.

Maskinganna are unable to dream themselves and are fascinated with the dreams of other creatures. They will take every opportunity to view the dreams of a sleeping creature, reveling in the sights and experiences of the dreamer.
